job.title: Computer Repair & Refurbish Technician
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Computer Repair & Refurbish Technician  to work at a company located in the Gravette, AR area!

Job Title: Computer Repair & Refurbish Technician 
 
Job Location: Gravette, AR
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $15 per hour
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Position Summary: 
 
The Repair/Refurb Technician role requires a detail-oriented, tech-savvy individual to troubleshoot, diagnose, log warranties, and repair various retail IT hardware, including POS systems, servers, printers, and handheld devices. The technician will perform hands-on maintenance, support technical and administrative work for client hardware, and be responsible for learning the company's internal systems for work logs and reporting, all within a fast-paced environment. 
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 
  1. Diagnose and troubleshoot issues with a wide range of IT hardware, including servers, desktops, laptops, tablets, cash registers, and POS systems, ensuring all customer hardware/software meets specifications. 
  2. Perform repairs and maintenance on equipment and parts, adhering strictly to customer contracts for warranty, third-party, and internal repairs. 
  3. Maintain accurate records for inventory and repairs, meeting both company and customer expectations. 
  4. Communicate effectively with the Supervisor regarding customer equipment status and needs. 
  5. Handle, package, and label products, assisting with the movement and sorting of goods up to 50 lbs (by hand or pallet jack). 
  6. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment by adhering to all safety guidelines, ESD requirements, and facility cleanliness standards. · Perform other duties as instructed.
 
Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities): 
 
  1. Strong technical, problem-solving, and diagnostic skills with meticulous attention to detail. 
  2. Effective communication skills and the ability to maintain a professional demeanor. 
  3. Ability to work effectively both independently (prioritizing tasks) and as part of a team, while accurately following instructions and repair documentation. 
  4. Physical ability to stand/sit for extended periods and lift/move heavy objects (up to 50 lbs) as needed. 
  5. Manual dexterity and proficiency in using hand tools. 
  6. Familiarity with safety procedures and comfort working in a warehouse environment. 
 
Physical Demands and Work Environment: 
 
  1. Time will be spent in a stockroom, warehouse, or loading dock receiving and transporting deliveries. 
  2. Moderate to heavy physical labor such as lifting and moving heavy items is required on a regular basis. 
  3. Temperature in the warehouse or dock varies according to external climate. 
  4. Standard 40-hour work week applies. 
  5. Based on the above essential functions, this job is considered a safety sensitive job function.

job.title: Double Pallet Jack Operator
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Double Pallet Jack Operator to work at a company located in the Lowell, AR area!

Job Title: Double Pallet Jack Operator
 
Job Location: Lowell, AR
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $18-$20 per hour
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Position Summary

 The Double Pallet Jack Operator safely operates an electric end-rider double pallet jack to transport, stage, load, and unload palletized products throughout a temperature-controlled food distribution center. Working primarily in cooler and freezer environments ranging from 34 degrees F to -10 degrees F, this role requires rapid, high-accuracy order selection and material movement while adhering strictly to OSHA regulations and food safety standards.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
  • Equipment Operation: Safely operate a motorized electric double pallet jack to transport product loads efficiently across dock and freezer floors.
  • Receiving & Staging: Unload inbound shipments, verify load stability, and transport incoming goods to specified cold storage locations or staging lanes.
  • Order Selection & Loading: Accurately pick full-pallet quantities using automated systems (RF scanners or Voice-to-Pick), ensuring proper weight distribution before loading outbound trailers.
  • Pre-Shift Inspections: Perform mandatory daily pre-operation safety checks on assigned equipment (brakes, steering, controls, battery status) and document findings per regulatory standards.
  • Cold-Chain Integrity: Execute tasks efficiently to ensure product exposure to ambient temperatures is minimized, strictly preserving the cold chain.
  • Chemical & Safety: Maintain a clean work environment by removing shrink wrap, damaged pallets, and debris from walkways. Comply with all standard warehouse safety guidelines and immediately report any product damages or equipment malfunctions.
 
Required Qualifications & Competencies
 
  • Experience: Minimum of 1 year of experience operating a powered industrial truck, specifically a motorized electric rider pallet jack, in a fast-paced environment.
  • Licensing & Certification: Must possess or be able to successfully pass the employer-administered OSHA Class III Powered Industrial Truck Certification within the first week of employment.
  • Technical Skills: Experience using warehouse management systems (WMS) and RF scanning barcode devices.
  • Mathematical Competency: Ability to read numbers, perform basic addition and subtraction, and visually confirm accuracy on inventory pick sheets.
 
Physical Demands & Work Environment
 
  • Temperature Extremes: Constant exposure to sub-freezing temperatures (34 degrees F down to -10 degrees F). Proper thermal personal protective equipment (PPE) will be provided.
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to stand and ride on the equipment platform for extended periods throughout an 8- to 10-hour shift.
  • Heavy Lifting: Ability to frequently lift, push, pull, or carry objects weighting up to 60 lbs without assistance to restack or secure shifted loads.
  • Agility: Frequent bending, crouching, reaching, and twisting while managing loads and navigating tight warehouse aisles.
 
 
 
 
 

The JobSquad Solutions Team is made up of experts around the country. Serving our local workforce communities is our passion.

job.title: Loading Assistant
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a  Loading Assistant to work at a company located in the Lowell, AR area!

Job Title: Loading Assistant
 
Job Location: Lowell, AR
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $18-$20 per hour
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Position Summary

The Loading Assistant works on the temperature-controlled loading docks to manually stage, wrap, load, and unload palletized products. This role ensures the fast, safe, and accurate movement of freight between the cold storage warehouse and outbound trailers while maintaining strict food safety and temperature control standards.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
  • Dock Operations: Manually load and unload freight from inbound and outbound trailers safely and efficiently.
  • Freight Staging: Securely stack, wrap, and stage product cases on pallets according to specific shipping manifests and order guides.
  • Quality & Inventory Control: Inspect incoming and outgoing shipments for damaged packaging, leaking boxes, or broken pallets, and immediately report defects to the supervisor.
  • Temperature Control: Keep dock doors closed when not actively loading to protect product quality and preserve the warehouse cold chain.
  • Cleanliness & Safety: Keep the shipping and receiving dock areas free of debris, broken wood, and shrink wrap to maintain a safe working environment.
 
Required Qualifications & Competencies
 
  • Experience: Previous experience in warehouse operations, general labor, or shipping/receiving environments is preferred but not required.
  • Technical Literacy: Ability to follow basic spoken and written instructions, read labels, and use basic barcode scanners if needed.
  • Reliability: Punctual attendance and the ability to work productively within a fast-paced team setting.
 
Physical Demands & Work Environment
 
  • Heavy Lifting: Ability to frequently lift, carry, and maneuver up to 60 lbs without help, and up to 100 lbs with help.
  • Work Environment: Constant exposure to a refrigerated warehouse dock environment (typically maintained around 34 degrees F to 38 degrees F).
  • Physical Endurance: Ability to stand, walk, bend, twist, and reach continuously throughout an 8- to 10-hour shift.

job.title: Poultry Production 1st/3rd shift
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a  Poultry Production 1st/3rd shift to work at a company located in the Milford, IN area!

Job Title:         Poultry Production 1st/3rd shift
 
Job Location:  Milford, IN
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $20 p/hr for 1st shift  $21 p/hr for 3rd shift
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Job responsibilities
 
Employees support the processing, inspection, and packaging of poultry products. Duties vary by department and may include:
 
Handling, sorting, and moving poultry products along the production line.
 
Trimming, cutting, or preparing products using knives, scissors, or approved equipment after training.
 
Inspecting products for quality concerns and reporting defects or contamination.
 
Packing products into designated containers and following instructions for counts, weights, labeling, and packaging.
 
 Physical requirements and work environment
 
Depending on the assignment, the position involves extended periods of standing or sitting, repetitive hand and arm movements, bending, reaching, and lifting materials weighing approximately 10–50 pounds. 
 
Employees work around raw poultry and production equipment. Conditions may include cold or hot temperatures, moisture, noise, and wet or slippery surfaces. Required protective equipment may include hairnets, beard nets, gloves, cut-resistant gloves, smocks, aprons, boots, and hearing protection.
 
Dress Code
Wear closed-toe, closed-heel footwear with slip-resistant soles. 
Follow plant restrictions on jewelry, watches, piercings, artificial nails, nail polish, and personal items including cell phones in production areas.
No sleeveless shirts, shorts - clothes must be clean and cannot have holes. Jeans cannot be torn, ripped, or frayed. 
Hygiene standards must be upheld.

job.title: Wastewater Treatment Technician
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Wastewater Treatment Technician to work at a company located in the Fort Wayne, IN area!

Job Title:    Wastewater Treatment Technician
 
Job Location:  Fort Wayne
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $19-$26 p/hr DOE 6am-4pm or 4pm-2am Mon-Thur.
 
Job Description:          
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Wastewater Treatment
•           Operate and monitor wastewater treatment equipment (clarifiers, filter presses, ion exchange, reverse osmosis, chemical feed systems, etc.)
•           Perform chemical treatment processes such as pH neutralization, metals precipitation, and chelation breaking for plating/finishing rinse waters
•           Collect and test water samples for pH, metals concentration (e.g., chromium, nickel, copper, zinc, cadmium), and other regulated parameters
•           Maintain accurate logs of chemical usage, flow rates, and lab results for regulatory compliance (EPA, local POTW permits)
•           Perform preventive maintenance and minor repairs on pumps, valves, tanks, and dosing systems
•           Manage handling, storage, and proper disposal of hazardous waste sludge (filter cake) in accordance with RCRA requirements
•           Order and manage inventory of treatment chemicals
•           Troubleshoot process upsets and adjust treatment parameters as needed
 
RoHS Compliance Support
•           Monitor use of RoHS-restricted substances in plating baths and processes, including lead, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, mercury, and certain brominated flame retardants/phthalates where applicable
•           Track substitution of restricted materials with RoHS-compliant alternatives (e.g., trivalent chromium in place of hexavalent chromium plating solutions)
•           Maintain documentation and traceability records supporting customer RoHS compliance declarations and Certificates of Conformance
•           Coordinate with quality/engineering teams on material composition testing (e.g., XRF screening) to verify plated parts meet RoHS threshold limits
•           Assist in maintaining Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and chemical inventory records reflecting RoHS status of process chemicals
•           Support internal and customer audits related to RoHS and REACH compliance
•           Stay current on updates to RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU and amendments) and related restricted substance regulations
 
 
General Compliance & Safety
•           Assist in preparing reports for regulatory agencies (e.g., discharge monitoring reports)
•           Follow all safety protocols when handling acids, caustics, and heavy metal-bearing solutions (PPE, spill response, SDS compliance)
•           Support broader environmental compliance initiatives (RCRA, REACH, Prop 65 as applicable)
•           Must be able to operate a forklift safely 
 
 
Qualifications
•           High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in environmental science, chemistry, or related field preferred
•           1–3+ years of experience in industrial wastewater treatment, plating operations, or a related field preferred
•           Working knowledge of pretreatment regulations and metal finishing discharge limits
•           Familiarity with RoHS/REACH restricted substance requirements strongly preferred
•           Basic chemistry skills and ability to perform lab titrations/tests
•           Mechanical aptitude for pump/valve maintenance
•           Ability to lift 50 lbs, work around chemicals, and wear required PPE
•           Wastewater certification (state-specific) a plus
 
 
Work Environment
•           Industrial plant setting with exposure to chemicals, fumes, and wet/humid conditions
•           May require rotating shifts, weekend, or on-call availability

job.title: Chemical Laboratory Technician
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Chemical Laboratory Technician to work at a company located in the Fort Wayne, IN area!

Job Title:    Chemical Laboratory Technician
 
Job Location:  Fort Wayne
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $18-$29 p/hr DOE 6am-4pm or 4pm-2am Mon-Thur.
 
Job Description:          
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
Laboratory Testing
●          Collect and prepare samples from plating lines, process tanks, and finished parts according to established sampling schedules and procedures.
●          Perform routine chemical analysis (titration, spectrophotometry, pH/conductivity testing, and similar methods) on plating bath chemistries and process solutions.
●          Record test results accurately and promptly in laboratory logs or laboratory information systems.
●          Flag out-of-specification results to the Chemical Laboratory Manager and assist with follow-up testing as needed.
●          Assist with sample analysis supporting wastewater treatment monitoring, as directed by the Chemical Laboratory Manager.
●          Maintain, clean, and perform basic upkeep of laboratory equipment and testing instruments; report equipment issues promptly.
Quality Support
●          Support inspection of finished parts for plating quality characteristics (e.g., thickness, adhesion, appearance) as directed.
●          Assist in documenting and investigating quality issues or customer complaints related to plating chemistry, under the guidance of the Chemical Laboratory Manager.
●          Help maintain organized, accurate laboratory records to support internal and customer quality audits.
●          Follow established quality control procedures and checklists consistently for all testing activities.
Safety and Housekeeping
●          Follow all laboratory safety procedures, including proper handling, labeling, and storage of laboratory chemicals.
●          Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory work area.
●          Properly dispose of laboratory waste and chemicals in accordance with company procedures and environmental regulations.
●          Report safety concerns, spills, or near-misses to the Chemical Laboratory Manager immediately.
 
This position has no supervisory responsibility. The Chemical Laboratory Technician works under the direct supervision of the Chemical Laboratory Manager.
 
Qualifications
 
Education and Experience
 
●          High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's degree or coursework in chemistry, laboratory science, or a related field preferred.
●          1-3 years of laboratory experience preferred; experience in a plating, metal finishing, or industrial laboratory setting is a plus.
●          On-the-job training will be provided for plating-specific testing methods and procedures.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
●          Basic understanding of chemistry and laboratory testing principles.
●          Ability to follow detailed testing procedures accurately and consistently.
●          Strong attention to detail and good recordkeeping habits.
●          Basic math skills, including the ability to perform calculations related to titration and solution concentrations.
●          Ability to work safely with laboratory and process chemicals.
●          Basic computer skills for data entry and recordkeeping.
●          Good communication skills for reporting results and flagging issues to the Laboratory Manager.
 
Physical Requirements
 
Ability to stand and work at lab benches for extended periods; ability to lift up to 25 lbs; ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including gloves, eye protection, and lab coats; occasional exposure to laboratory and process chemicals.
 
Work Environment
 
Work is performed primarily in the on-site chemical laboratory, with regular time on the production floor to collect samples. Exposure to laboratory chemicals, plating solutions, and related odors is expected; appropriate PPE and safety protocols must be followed at all times.

job.title: Food Safety & Quality Manager
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Food Safety & Quality Manager  to work at a company located in the Doral, FL area!

Job Title: Food Safety & Quality Manager 
Job Location:   Doral 
Pay and Hours Temp to Hire   Salary Range / Rate: $85K – $105K 
 
Position Summary
The Food Safety & Quality Manager will be responsible for overseeing and maintaining all food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance programs within the salmon processing facility. This position will ensure that products are manufactured, handled, stored, and shipped in accordance with company standards, customer specifications, FDA/USDA requirements, HACCP guidelines, and applicable seafood industry regulations.
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, hands-on experience in food manufacturing or seafood processing, and a solid understanding of HACCP, GMPs, sanitation, quality systems, and regulatory compliance.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage and oversee the plant’s Food Safety and Quality Assurance programs.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain HACCP plans and prerequisite programs.
  • Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor production processes to ensure food safety and product quality standards are consistently met.
  • Conduct regular inspections of production areas, equipment, products, and processes.
  • Oversee environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, allergen control, and microbiological testing programs.
  • Review and maintain food safety and quality documentation, records, and reports.
  • Investigate product quality issues, customer complaints, non-conformances, and food safety incidents.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Work closely with Production, Sanitation, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Operations teams to identify and resolve quality and food safety concerns.
  • Establish and monitor quality specifications for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished products.
  • Verify temperature controls throughout receiving, processing, storage, and shipping.
  • Ensure proper handling and storage of salmon and other seafood products to maintain product integrity and food safety.
  • Conduct internal audits and coordinate customer, third-party, and regulatory audits.
  • Maintain relationships and communication with regulatory agencies, customers, laboratories, and third-party auditors as needed.
  • Train and coach employees on GMPs, HACCP, food safety, sanitation, personal hygiene, and quality procedures.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations, seafood industry standards, and customer requirements.
  • Review production and quality data to identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Ensure timely completion and accuracy of all food safety and quality records.
  • Participate in product traceability, mock recalls, and recall procedures when necessary.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives related to food safety, quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
 
Required Qualifications
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in food science, Food Safety, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry, or a related field preferred.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in food manufacturing, seafood processing, or a related industry.
  • Previous management or supervisory experience in a food safety or quality role.
 
Preferred Qualifications
 
  • Seafood or salmon processing experience.
  • SQF, BAP, ASC and other GFSI certification experience.
  • Experience with environmental monitoring programs.
  • Experience with microbiological testing and laboratory coordination.
  • Experience managing customer specifications and audits.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.
 
Physical & Work Environment
 
  • Work is performed in a refrigerated seafood processing environment.
  • Ability to work around wet floors, cold temperatures, machinery, noise, and seafood processing equipment.
  • Ability to walk and stand for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to wear required PPE and follow all plant safety and food safety requirements.
  • Must be comfortable working on the production floor and interacting directly with production employees and supervisors.
 
Key Skills
 
  • Food Safety & Quality Assurance
  • HACCP & GMP
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Seafood Processing
  • Quality Control
  • Auditing
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Corrective & Preventive Actions (CAPA)
  • Sanitation & Environmental Monitoring
  • Team Leadership
 
Salary Range / Rate: $85K – $105K
• 401(k) + Health Insurance
• 15 Days of Vacation
• 4 Paid Holidays
• Full-Time — must be available to work 1 Saturday per month
Additional Information
  • Target Start Date: ASAP
  • Required vs. Preferred Certifications:
     HACCP is required.
     BAP/ASC certification is preferred.
  • Required English and Spanish Level: Spanish required / Advanced English (must be able to lead an audit)

job.title: QA & Food Safety Supervisor
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Assistant Food Safety and Quality Assurance Manager to work at a company located in the Alma, GA area!

Job Title: Assistant Food Safety and Quality Assurance Manager  
 
Job Location: Alma, GA
 
Salary: $65k to $90k depending on experience 
 
Shift: 6am to 3pm
 
Bilingual – English/Spanish Preferred
 

Job Description: 
 
  • ****Must have five years of experience in the food industry
  • Serve as the designated liaison between the plant and FSIS; keep current with USDA/FSIS regulations and ensure compliance with requirements related to plant conditions, Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures, HACCP, GMPs, labeling, microbiology, allergen control, and prerequisite programs.
  • Assist in writing, implementing, verifying, and maintaining food safety and quality procedures and programs to produce safe food with acceptable quality attributes, including documentation, document control, and record retention.
  • Oversee BRC implementation and management, including food safety fundamentals,
  • HACCP-based food safety plans, food quality plans, verification activities, internal audits, and external supplier audits as needed.
  • Investigate customer complaints, determine appropriate corrective and preventive actions, and ensure complaint responses and documentation are completed.
  • Maintain and verify the pest control program, including monitoring contracted service reports, open conditions, program effectiveness, and required records.
  • Maintain product traceability for ingredients, supplies, raw materials, packaging, and finished products, including supplier database activities and records to support recall or recovery events.
  • Maintain the written recall program and test its effectiveness through mock recalls.
  • Provide and coordinate food safety and quality training for management, employees, and team members, including HACCP and other applicable food safety training required by the training program.
  • Maintain and verify the Food Defense Program to ensure it remains current and properly implemented.
  • Review FSIS export library requirements and ensure required export procedures and documentation are followed when product is exported.
  • Oversee laboratory functions, scientific testing, environmental programs for raw and cooked facilities, and corrective or preventive actions based on results.
  • Ensure food safety and quality requirements are considered during new product development and that regulatory compliance is maintained.
  • Conduct yield tests, maintain related data, and report results as required.
  • Maintain Sanitation Programs and related sanitation support activities assigned to the Food Safety and Quality Assurance function.
  • Develop and update food safety manuals, SOPs, and program documents as needed for new programs or changes to existing programs.
  • Conduct validations of CCPs and intervention systems and implement corrective actions for food safety deficiencies as needed.
  • Maintain food safety files and records, returned goods and hold logs, foreign object investigation logs, and other required compliance records
 
Supervisory Responsibilities               
Directly supervises employees in the Food Safety and Quality Assurance Department, including Quality Assurance Supervisors, QA and HACCP Assistant, Quality Assurance Technicians, and other assigned personnel. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
 
Computer Skills
Must have proficient computer skills and an understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and Access as well as experience in labeling software for development (Label Matrix, Byzerba, or similar) and for label approval (EZ Form or similar).
 
Certificates, Licenses, Registrations  
• HACCP certified   
• Food Safety and Handling certifications.
 
 
Education: 
Minimum Bachelor of Science degree in Food Science, Biology, Chemistry, Meat Science, Microbiology, or a related field. OR a minimum of five years of experience in the food industry with knowledge of the responsibilities listed in this job description.

Job Description:       
 
Food manufacturing company in Des Plaines, IL is looking for a 1st Shift Controls Maint. Technician. 
 
Summary of role:
This position will be responsible for development, testing and implementation of all programming and electrical controls. This would include all programmable controller platforms, graphical user interface platforms, gateways, AC/DC electrical schematic development and debugging as well as training personnel on these systems both operationally and technically. This position is key to the company as most of the systems in place currently need to be upgraded and there are many missing electrical schematics this position could help to develop for troubleshooting purposes.
 
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Duties may include, but are not limited to the following:
  • Electrical System project management.
  • Electrical/Programming troubleshooting.
  • Electrical/Programming training of technicians.
  • Manage inventory of print library/archive and backups for all machines.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
  • Electrical System knowledge and experience to include VFD(s), Servos, high and low voltage troubleshooting.
  • Ability and experience troubleshooting and modifying Electrical/PLC-GUI Programming/Controls
  • Ability to use laptop to troubleshoot a PLC problem.
  • Ability to use laptop to point a Maintenance Technician to a machine problem.
  • Ability to troubleshoot scale, x-ray, and checkweigher problems.
  • Ability to resolve VFD, Servo, safety module or miscellaneous drive faults.
  • Ability to make PLC program modifications and tuning adjustments (timers, fault capture)
  • Possess a basic understanding of PID loops.
  • AutoCAD electrical schematic one-line drawing development preferred but not required.
  • AutoCAD mechanical drawing development preferred but not required.
  • NFPA 70E Arc Flash safety certification is a plus.
  • Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to read and write in English.

Job Description:          
 
The CNC Machinist (Grade 2) is responsible for independently producing precision machined parts by setting up, programming, and operating CNC equipment with minimal supervision. This role requires strong technical competency in machining practices, program editing and creation, tooling selection, and quality verification. The Grade 2 machinist supports manufacturing operations by ensuring efficient setups, maintaining process accuracy, troubleshooting issues, and consistently meeting quality and productivity standards.
 
Key Responsibilities:
• Read, interpret, and follow work orders, blueprints, engineering drawings, and specifications.
• Measure and verify part dimensions using comparators, calipers, micrometers, bore gages, height gages, indicators, and other precision  tools.
• Independently set up, operate, and monitor CNC machines within the assigned department.

• Operate equipment unsupervised while maintaining consistent output and adherence to specifications.
• Troubleshoot machining issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
• Meet or exceed standard productivity requirements and follow established manufacturing processes.
• Accurately report time, materials, and job progress in manufacturing systems.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area.
• Perform routine equipment checks, basic maintenance, and communicate repair needs.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to process enhancements.
• Perform other duties as assigned.
 
Preferred Skills:
• Proficiency in safely operating CNC and manual shop equipment.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and understanding of machining principles.
• 2+ years of machining or manufacturing experience.
• Ability to operate manual machines (lathe, mill, grinder).
• Working knowledge of CNC controls, instrumentation, and machining processes.
• Ability to write, edit, and troubleshoot CNC programs.
• Strong computer skills, including Excel, Word, and ERP systems.
• Excellent functional and technical skills with strong attention to detail.
• Clear verbal communication and documentation abilities.
• Ability to follow instructions, ask questions when needed, and learn new processes quickly.
 
Personal Attributes:
• Dependable and punctual, with consistent attendance.
• Able to work independently with minimal supervision or collaboratively as part of a team.
• Strong problem-solving mindset with sound judgment.
• Quality-focused with a commitment to continuous improvement.
• Self-motivated, adaptable, and eager to grow within the CNC machining trade.
 
Physical Demands:
• Prolonged standing throughout the shift.
• Occasional stooping, kneeling, or crouching.
• Regularly lift and move up to 50 lbs.
• Frequent exposure to grease, oils, noise, and coolant in a manufacturing environment.

job.title: PCB Designer-Level II
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a PCP Designer – Level II to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: PCP Designer – Level II

Job Location: Coral Gables 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $80K

Job Description
The PCB Designer (Mid-Level) is responsible for the design and layout of complex printed circuit boards for avionics systems, operating with a high degree of independence. This role applies strong knowledge of signal integrity, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and electrostatic discharge (ESD) principles to develop reliable, high-quality designs. The PCB Designer implements advanced design constraints, including differential pair routing, impedance control, and trace length matching, and plays a key role in supporting system integration through cross-functional collaboration. Utilizing industry-standard ECAD tools, this role contributes to design strategy, identifies opportunities for process improvement, and helps drive quality and efficiency across the PCB development lifecycle.

 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 • Design and develop complex, multi-layer PCB layouts for avionics systems, including high-speed digital, analog, RF, and power circuits.
 • Apply advanced signal integrity and power integrity constraints, including differential pair routing, impedance control, controlled trace lengths, and propagation delay considerations.
 • Develop and maintain electrical schematics of moderate complexity, ensuring proper component selection, connectivity, and alignment with layout and system requirements.
 • Ensure compliance with EMC/EMI and ESD protection standards throughout the design lifecycle.
 • Prepare and release complete fabrication and assembly documentation packages, including Gerbers, ODB++, drill files, drawings, and bills of materials (BOMs).
 • Collaborate cross-functionally with electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering teams to support optimal design solutions and successful system integration.
 • Participate in and contribute to design reviews, including engineering, DFM, and DFA evaluations, incorporating feedback into designs.
 • Support prototyping, debugging, and design iterations based on test results and production feedback.
 • Maintain and enhance PCB libraries, components, and design templates within the CAD/Altium environment.
 • Ensure adherence to aerospace standards, internal processes, and configuration control requirements.
 • Interface with manufacturing teams, including SMT production, to support builds and help resolve design-related issues.
 • Perform root cause analysis for PCB-related issues and contribute to corrective actions.
 • Provide input on layout effort, timelines, and design complexity during project planning.
 • Support knowledge sharing and contribute to team best practices.
 • Engage with internal stakeholders on design considerations to ensure alignment with program requirements.
 • Identify opportunities for process improvements and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
 
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
 • Associate degree, PCB Design technical certification, or equivalent experience in electronics or circuit design.
 • Minimum 4 years of experience in PCB layout, preferably in high-reliability or regulated environments (aerospace experience a plus).
 • Working knowledge of IPC standards (e.g., IPC-2221, IPC-7351, IPC-A-600) and their application in PCB design.
 • Experience applying high-speed PCB design principles, including differential pair routing, impedance control, and basic signal integrity considerations.
 • Proficiency with industry-standard ECAD tools, such as Altium Designer and/or Cadence Allegro/OrCAD.
 • Familiarity with rigid-flex and/or HDI PCB technologies.
 • Solid understanding of PCB fabrication and assembly processes, with the ability to support manufacturing handoffs and issue resolution.
 • Awareness of EMI/EMC design practices and electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection methods.
 • Ability to interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and manufacturing specifications.
 • Experience working within structured quality systems (e.g., AS9100 or ISO9001) preferred.
 • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.

 PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
 • Sedentary Work- This role may require exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently to lift carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Most essential functions are performed while sitting but walking and standing is required as needed.
 • Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, and specialized design tools.
 • Visual acuity required to review detailed schematics, PCB layouts, and technical drawings on-screen and in print.
 • Ability to communicate effectively in person, via phone, and through virtual meetings.
 • Ability to access and navigate laboratory or production areas, including SMT manufacturing environments, when supporting builds or troubleshooting activities.

The Buyer is responsible for purchasing materials, components, equipment, and services required to support Gables Engineering’s avionics manufacturing and production operations.

The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Buyer to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: Buyer 
Job Location: Coral Gables 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $65K to $70K

Job Description
The Buyer is responsible for purchasing materials, components, equipment, and services required to support Gables Engineering’s avionics manufacturing and production operations.
This position works closely with Engineering, Production, Quality, Inventory, and Supply Chain teams to ensure materials are purchased at the appropriate cost, quality, and delivery schedule while maintaining compliance with aerospace quality standards and company purchasing procedures.

Key Responsibilities
  • Purchase electronic components, raw materials, hardware, mechanical parts, and manufacturing supplies used in avionics production.
  • Review purchase requisitions and issue purchase orders to approved suppliers.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations based on price, quality, availability, lead time, and delivery requirements.
  • Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, minimum order quantities, and purchasing terms with vendors.
  • Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with suppliers regarding delivery status.
  • Expedite critical materials when necessary to prevent production delays.
  • Coordinate with Production Planning and Inventory teams to maintain adequate material availability.
  • Work closely with Engineering regarding specifications, drawings, bills of material, and component requirements.
  • Assist in identifying alternate suppliers and components when shortages or obsolescence issues occur.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier documentation, pricing, delivery dates, and purchase-order information.
  • Resolve supplier issues involving late deliveries, shortages, damaged materials, incorrect parts, or quality concerns.
  • Coordinate with Quality and Incoming Inspection regarding rejected or nonconforming materials.
  • Process supplier returns and corrective-action requests when appropriate.
  • Review inventory levels and purchasing requirements to reduce excess inventory and material shortages.
  • Support cost-reduction and supplier-performance initiatives.
  • Maintain relationships with domestic and international suppliers.
  • Ensure purchasing activities comply with company quality procedures and applicable aerospace requirements.
  • Assist with supplier evaluations, approved-vendor documentation, and purchasing audits.
  • Communicate potential material shortages or supply-chain risks to management.
  • Support Engineering and Production with prototype, new-product, and special-project purchasing requirements.

Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma required; Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Operations, Procurement, or related field preferred.
  • 2–5 years of purchasing or buyer experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Aerospace, avionics, electronics, defense, or precision manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience purchasing electronic components, mechanical parts, raw materials, or production supplies.
  • Strong understanding of purchase orders, RFQs, supplier quotations, pricing, and lead times.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor-management skills.
  • Ability to read and understand part numbers, bills of material, engineering specifications, and purchasing documentation.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and ERP/MRP systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working within an AS9100 or ISO 9001 manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of aerospace purchasing and supplier-quality requirements.
  • Experience purchasing electronic components such as:
    • PCBs
    • Integrated circuits
    • Connectors
    • Switches
    • Displays
    • Wiring components
    • Hardware
    • Machined parts
  • Experience with ERP or MRP purchasing systems.
  • Knowledge of supplier qualification and approved-vendor processes.
  • Familiarity with material traceability, certificates of conformity, and aerospace documentation.
  • Experience managing component shortages and obsolete electronic parts.

Core Competencies
  • Purchasing & Procurement
  • Aerospace Manufacturing
  • Vendor Management
  • Supplier Negotiation
  • Purchase Orders
  • RFQs
  • Inventory Control
  • Material Planning
  • Electronic Components
  • ERP / MRP Systems
  • Cost Analysis
  • Supplier Performance
  • Quality Compliance
  • Production Support
  • Supply Chain Coordination

Position Objective
The Buyer supports Gables Engineering’s manufacturing operation by ensuring the correct materials and components are available on time, at the appropriate quality level, and at competitive cost, helping maintain production schedules and customer-delivery commitments.

job.title: PCB Designer -Principal
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Software Engineer III to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: Software Engineer III  
Job Location: Coral Gables 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:
$115k to $120K

Job Description:
Position Summary
The Software Engineer III is a senior-level engineering position responsible for the design, development, integration, debugging, and verification of embedded software used in advanced commercial aircraft avionics and cockpit control systems.
This position works closely with electrical, systems, test, and manufacturing engineering teams to develop reliable, safety-critical software solutions from initial concept through production release. The Software Engineer III will also provide technical guidance to junior engineers and contribute to software architecture, design reviews, troubleshooting, and continuous product improvement.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain embedded software for avionics equipment and aircraft control systems.
  • Develop software using C/C++, assembly language, and other embedded programming technologies.
  • Participate in requirements analysis, software architecture, detailed design, coding, integration, and verification.
  • Develop and maintain software for microprocessors, microcontrollers, DSPs, and embedded control platforms.
  • Analyze system and software requirements and translate them into reliable technical solutions.
  • Perform software and hardware integration testing.
  • Troubleshoot complex interactions between embedded software, electronics, processors, communication buses, and peripheral devices.
  • Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions for new avionics products and enhancements.
  • Participate in software verification activities for both personally developed software and software developed by other engineers.
  • Conduct peer reviews, code reviews, design reviews, and technical documentation reviews.
  • Investigate software defects, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Optimize embedded software for reliability, memory utilization, execution speed, and overall system performance.
  • Work closely with hardware engineers to resolve board-level and system-level technical issues.
  • Support engineering testing, qualification testing, manufacturing, and production troubleshooting.
  • Maintain software documentation, specifications, test procedures, revision records, and engineering reports.
  • Assist with software configuration management and version-control processes.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to Software Engineer I and II team members.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives involving software development and verification processes.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Typically 5+ years of professional embedded software development experience, preferably in aerospace, avionics, defense, electronics, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Strong programming experience with C and C++.
  • Experience with embedded systems and real-time software development.
  • Experience programming and debugging microprocessors or microcontrollers.
  • Working knowledge of assembly language programming.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle principles.
  • Experience troubleshooting both software and hardware-related issues.
  • Knowledge of software verification, debugging, testing, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience using source-code control and software configuration-management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering specifications.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience developing commercial aviation or avionics software.
  • Knowledge of DO-178 software-development principles or other aerospace software-development standards.
  • Experience with Digital Signal Processing (DSP).
  • Familiarity with Audio CODECs and embedded audio systems.
  • Experience with aircraft communication protocols such as ARINC 429, CAN, RS-232/422/485, or similar communication interfaces.
  • Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Familiarity with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, debuggers, emulators, and other electronic test equipment.
  • Previous experience working with safety-critical or mission-critical embedded systems.
Core Competencies
  • Embedded Software Development
  • C/C++ Programming
  • Assembly Language
  • Avionics Systems
  • Embedded Controls
  • Software Verification & Validation
  • Hardware/Software Integration
  • Technical Troubleshooting
  • Root-Cause Analysis
  • Software Architecture
  • Configuration Management
  • Engineering Documentation
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Technical Mentoring

job.title: EHS Administrator III
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Environmental, Health and Safety Administrator  to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

 
Job Title: Environmental, Health and Safety Administrator 
 
Job Location: Coral Gables, FL 33146
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $85k per year 
 
Job Description:
Seeking an experienced EHS Administrator III to support and administer Environmental, Health, and Safety programs within its aerospace manufacturing operation. This position is responsible for helping ensure compliance with federal, state, and local environmental and occupational safety regulations while promoting a safe and compliant workplace.
The EHS Administrator III will work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Facilities, and Human Resources to identify workplace hazards, maintain regulatory documentation, coordinate training, support audits and inspections, and assist with incident investigations and corrective actions.
 
Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Administer and support company Environmental, Health, and Safety programs and procedures.
  • Monitor compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, Florida environmental, and local safety regulations.
  • Conduct routine workplace safety inspections and identify unsafe conditions or practices.
  • Assist with job hazard analyses, risk assessments, and corrective-action plans.
  • Maintain EHS records, logs, permits, inspection reports, training documentation, and compliance files.
  • Maintain and support OSHA injury and illness recordkeeping requirements.
  • Assist with workplace incident, injury, near-miss, and environmental investigations.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis and track corrective and preventive actions through completion.
  • Coordinate and deliver employee safety orientation and ongoing EHS training.
Support programs involving:
  • Hazard Communication
  • Personal Protective Equipment
  • Lockout/Tagout
  • Machine Safety
  • Ergonomics
  • Emergency Response
  • Electrical Safety
  • Chemical Handling
  • Hazardous Waste
  • Spill Prevention and Response
  • Review Safety Data Sheets and maintain chemical inventories.
  • Coordinate proper handling, storage, labeling, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
  • Assist with environmental permits, reporting requirements, and regulatory submissions.
  • Conduct internal EHS audits and participate in external regulatory or customer audits.
  • Work with production and engineering personnel to evaluate new equipment, manufacturing processes, and facility modifications for EHS risks.
  • Support emergency preparedness drills, evacuation procedures, and response plans.
  • Monitor safety trends and recommend continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Prepare EHS reports, presentations, metrics, and management summaries.
  • Communicate safety requirements to employees, supervisors, contractors, and visitors.
  • Support contractor safety and facility safety programs.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Typically 3–5+ years of Environmental, Health, and Safety experience, preferably within manufacturing, aerospace, electronics, or another regulated industrial environment.
  • Working knowledge of OSHA occupational-safety requirements.
  • Familiarity with EPA and environmental compliance requirements.
  • Experience conducting safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments.
  • Experience with accident and incident investigations.
  • Strong knowledge of corrective-action and root-cause-analysis processes.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and apply them to manufacturing operations.
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Aerospace, aviation, electronics, or precision-manufacturing experience.
  • Experience working in an AS9100 or ISO-regulated manufacturing environment.
  • OSHA 30-Hour General Industry certification.
  • HAZWOPER or hazardous-material-handling training.
  • First Aid/CPR certification.
  • Knowledge of industrial hygiene monitoring.
  • Experience with hazardous waste and environmental reporting.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing equipment, machine guarding, chemical processes, and facility safety.

job.title: PC Test Technician I
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a PC Test Technician I to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: PC Test Technician I
Job Location: Coral Gables 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:
$25/hr to $26/HR
Job Description
 PC Test Technician I
Company: Gables Engineering, Inc.
 Department: Quality / Testing
Position Summary
The PC Test Technician I is responsible for inspecting, testing, and troubleshooting electronic aircraft components used in communication, navigation, and flight control systems. This role performs visual, operational, and functional testing to ensure all components meet Gables Engineering's quality standards and applicable aviation requirements.
The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in electronics, experience using electronic test equipment, and the ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and manuals. Avionics experience is preferred.

Primary Responsibilities
  • Perform operational, visual, and functional testing of electronic aircraft components to ensure compliance with company quality standards.
  • Conduct various tests, including:
    • Visual inspections
    • Electrical continuity testing
    • Functional testing
    • Software flashing and loading
  • Operate specialized test equipment to monitor and simulate data transmission using ARINC 429, CSDB signals, and CAN simulators.
  • Document test results and complete acceptance test reports, ensuring all units under test (UUTs) have the required documentation and are ready for inspection.
  • Troubleshoot electronic components, identify malfunctions, and perform basic repairs based on test results and technical analysis.
  • Use dedicated computer software to perform testing and document results.
  • Participate in customer and Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) audits as required.
  • Collaborate with engineers and other team members to support testing requirements and project deadlines.
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • Strong understanding of electronic theory and component-level troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, engineering drawings, and technical manuals.
  • Experience operating electronic test equipment, including:
    • Digital multimeters
    • Oscilloscopes
    • Specialized avionics test equipment
    • Equipment used for environmental testing
  • Strong computer skills and the ability to operate specialized testing software.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while supporting engineers.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees at all levels.
Required Experience and Education
  • Associate degree in Electronics or a related field, or equivalent military training or technical trade experience.
  • Minimum of one year of experience in electronics testing, troubleshooting, or repair.
  • Avionics experience is preferred but not required.
Physical Requirements
Light Work: This position requires occasionally lifting or moving up to 20 pounds and frequently lifting or moving up to 10 pounds.
  • Most essential job functions are performed while sitting, with occasional walking and standing.
  • Manual dexterity is required for assembling, fabricating, and handling small electronic components, involving repetitive movements of the hands, wrists, and fingers.
  • Visual acuity is required to inspect circuit boards, identify small defects, handle small components, and use precision measurement instruments.
Company: Gables Engineering, Inc.

Job Description:                                                          
 
Position Summary

job.title: Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance  to work at a company located in the Claremore, OK area!

Job Title: Septic Truck Operator/Maintenance 
 
Job Location: Claremore, Ok
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $25-$45 p/hr DOE 90 Day full benefits
 
Job Description:                                                           
 
Daily Duties & Responsibilities
  • Pre-Trip Inspections: Check truck fluids, tires, brakes, vacuum pumps, and secure all hoses and valves. 
  • Site Preparation: Locate underground tanks, dig to expose access lids using tools like a rock bar or soil probe, and manage physical labor on site. 
  • Waste Extraction: Hook up suction hoses, operate vacuum pump systems, and carefully monitor waste flow to prevent spills. 
  • Transportation & Disposal: Drive loaded tanker waste securely to an approved municipal or regional treatment facility. 
  • Customer Service: Answer client questions regarding the pumping process and note any structural damage or failing components inside the septic system. 

Equipment Maintenance Checklist
  • Daily Checks: Inspect suction hoses for cracks, soft spots, or loose clamps; test valves for smooth operation.
  • Weekly Tasks: Clear debris from tank baffles, clean sludge buildup, and inspect the primary shut-off float and manway gaskets.
  • Monthly & Routine Servicing: Check fluid levels, grease PTO shafts, inspect vacuum pump performance, and test vehicle battery terminals for corrosion.
 
Requirements
  • Reasonable Driving Background: CDL Preferred, not required. 
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to lift heavy items (frequently over 50 to 150 lbs) and work outdoors in varied weather conditions.
  • Safety & Compliance: Strict adherence to Department of Transportation (DOT) and environmental waste disposal guidelines. 
 
 
90 days will move to permanent employee, and become eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401k program.
 
Position will be paid overtime past base hours and can be considered on call.

job.title: Senior HR Business Partner
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Bilingual Senior Human Resources Business Partner to work at a manufacturing company located in the Bloomingdale, IL area!

Job Title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner (Bilingual)
 
Job Location: Bloomingdale, IL 60108
 
Salary: $100,000-$115,000 base plus bonus 
 
 
Job Description    
                                 
 
Position Summary:

The Senior Human Resources Business Partner (Sr. HRBP) serves as a strategic and hands-on partner to leadership, driving both day-to-day HR operations and long-term organizational effectiveness. This role is critical in supporting the company’s planned growth and scaling initiatives, with a focus on building strong talent pipelines, enhancing organizational culture, and implementing scalable HR processes across multiple locations.
Primarily supporting manufacturing operations in Bloomingdale and Glendale Heights, IL (additional manufacturing sites in NM and NC as support is required), this role requires a balance of strategic insight and tactical execution across all facets of Human Resources. The Sr. HRBP will influence leaders at all levels, lead change initiatives, and ensure HR practices align with business objectives to enable the organization to scale effectively.
The ideal candidate is a proactive, results-driven HR professional with experience in manufacturing environments, known for strong communication, sound judgment, and the ability to drive measurable improvements in culture, engagement, and performance.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
Strategic Business Partnership
  • Partner with leadership to align HR strategies with business objectives, supporting organizational growth and scalability. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, and talent development. 
  • Drive change management initiatives to support business transformation and continuous improvement. 
Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning
  • Lead full-cycle recruitment strategies for hourly and salaried roles, ensuring alignment with growth goals. 
  • Partner with hiring managers to forecast workforce needs and build proactive talent pipelines. 
  • Enhance employer branding and recruitment processes to attract high-quality talent in a competitive manufacturing market. 
Employee Relations & Culture
  • Lead and manage complex employee relations issues, including investigations, corrective actions, and conflict resolution. 
  • Champion a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture across all locations. 
  • Identify trends and implement initiatives to improve engagement, retention, and employee experience. 
Performance Management & Talent Development
  • Provide coaching and guidance to leaders on performance management, employee development, and succession planning. 
  • Facilitate performance and compensation review processes, ensuring consistency and fairness. 
  • Support leadership capability development through training and coaching. 
HR Operations & Compliance
  • Oversee core HR processes including onboarding, offboarding, benefits administration, leaves of absence (FMLA, STD, workers’ compensation), and HRIS data integrity. 
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local employment laws across multiple locations. 
  • Maintain and improve HR policies, procedures, and employee handbook. 
Process Improvement & HR Infrastructure
  • Evaluate and enhance HR processes to support scalability and operational efficiency. 
  • Leverage HRIS and data analytics to drive insights, reporting, and decision-making. 
  • Lead or support HR-related projects, including system implementations and process standardization. 
Employee Engagement & Communication
  • Develop and execute engagement initiatives, including wellness and recognition programs. 
  • Deliver clear, consistent, and effective communication across all levels of the organization. 
  • Serve as a visible and accessible HR presence on the plant floor and within the office environment. 
Leadership & Team Support
  • May directly manage or mentor HR team members, including recruiting support. 
  • Serve as a backup to the Human Resources Director as needed. 
 
 
Qualifications & Education:
 
 
  • Bilingual (Spanish/English) is required. 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or related field required 
  • 8+ years of progressive HR experience, preferably within a manufacturing environment 
  • Master's degree or HR-related certification (SHRM-CP/SPHR) preferred
  • Demonstrated success in: 
    • Driving organizational change and growth initiatives 
    • Improving employee engagement and culture 
    • Building and optimizing HR processes 
    • Influencing and coaching leaders 
  • Strong employee relations experience, including handling complex situations independently 
  • Experience supporting multi-site operations; multi-state experience preferred 
 
Technical & Professional Skills
 
  • Experience with HRIS systems (Paycom or similar required) 
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills (advanced Excel proficiency preferred) 
  • Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal 
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • High level of discretion and confidentiality 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment 
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision and highly collaborative
 

 
Benefits: 
 
Employee benefits include:
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • 401k Savings Plan

job.description:

Job Title: Septic Installer/Maintenance 
 
Job Location: Claremore, Ok
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $25-$45 p/hr DOE 90 days full benefits         
 
Job Description:                                                          
Septic installer and maintenance technician will install, repair, and service onsite wastewater treatment systems for residential and commercial properties.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Installation: Excavate sites, set septic tanks, lay distribution pipes, and construct drain fields according to local building codes and permits. 
  • Maintenance & Pumping: Locate system components, uncover access lids, and operate pump trucks to remove accumulated sludge and waste. 
  • Inspection & Diagnostics: Assess structural integrity, check liquid levels and baffles, inspect pumps and filters, and troubleshoot system failures.
  • Repairs: Replace damaged pipes, broken baffles, failing pumps, or worn-out risers and valves. 
  • Site Work: Operate heavy machinery like mini-excavators, skid steers, and trenchers, followed by proper backfilling and site grading.
 
Qualifications & Requirements
 
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to lift heavy objects (often 50 to 150 lbs) and perform strenuous outdoor labor in all weather conditions.
  • Equipment Skills: Experience operating excavation machinery and specialized plumbing or pumping tools.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of local environmental and health regulations regarding wastewater disposal
  • 90 days will move to permanent employee, and become eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401k program.


     Position will be paid overtime past base hours and can be considered on call.

Job Title: Mechanical & Controls Estimator   
 
Job Location: Fort Lauderdale 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $90,000 – $105,000 direct hire health, vision, dental, 401k
 
Job Description:          
The Mechanical / BMS Controls Estimator is responsible for reviewing project plans, specifications, and drawings to develop accurate and comprehensive estimates for mechanical systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), and HVAC controls.
This position requires a strong understanding of mechanical and controls systems, estimating principles, project costing, and the integration of building automation systems with HVAC and other building equipment. The Estimator will work closely with Project Management, Engineering, Operations, Sales, subcontractors, and vendors throughout the bidding and project turnover process. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Evaluate bid specifications and drawings for mechanical and BMS control systems, including chilled water, condenser water, glycol, refrigeration, and other mechanical systems. 
  • Review electrical systems as they relate to controls scope and system integration. 
  • Develop RFIs, clarifications, and scope reviews to ensure a complete understanding of project requirements. 
  • Perform accurate takeoffs and develop detailed cost estimates for controls, mechanical systems, and associated components. 
  • Analyze project requirements and identify potential technical challenges, labor constraints, integration issues, and other factors that could impact project budgets or execution. 
  • Understand low-voltage BMS controls, control system topology, networking requirements, and interfaces between controls, mechanical equipment, and building systems. 
  • Evaluate the integration of building automation systems with HVAC equipment, lighting controls, generators, and other building systems. 
  • Determine controls and mechanical scope requirements and identify integrated versus non-integrated equipment. 
  • Perform comprehensive bid-day analysis and scope reviews. 
  • Review bid requirements and identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and items requiring clarification. 
  • Prepare subcontractor bid packages and ensure appropriate vendor and subcontractor participation. 
  • Develop and maintain relationships with subcontractors and vendors while soliciting and evaluating quotations. 
  • Communicate project schedules, bid requirements, and addenda to vendors and subcontractors. 
  • Create and maintain bid lists to ensure appropriate coverage for each project. 
  • Enter and maintain project and estimating information within estimating software and internal systems. 
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Engineers, Operations, and Sales to ensure estimates and scope assumptions align with operational capabilities. 
  • Ensure bid documents, vendor quotations, subcontractor information, scope assumptions, and project details are accurately transferred to the Project Management team. 
  • Review drawings and project costs with Project Management and identify potential risks or areas of concern. 
  • Conduct site visits as needed to support retrofit opportunities and estimate development. 
  • Maintain effective communication with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal departments. 
  • Submit bids, budgets, and estimating deliverables within established deadlines. 

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field preferred. 
  • 3–5 years of experience within construction, project environments, estimating, or related business operations. 
  • Experience with or willingness to learn Mechanical Systems, BMS, BAS, HVAC controls, and related technologies. 
  • Understanding of low-voltage control systems, controls integration, and mechanical equipment applications. 
  • Understanding of chilled water, condenser water, and refrigeration systems. 
  • Ability to read and interpret plans, specifications, addenda, drawings, and RFIs. 
  • Understanding of estimating principles, margins, and project costing. 
  • Experience using estimating software. 
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Project. 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities. 
  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills. 
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to learning and professional development. 
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus. 

Benefits
Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package are offered.

job.title: Local CDL Driver
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a CDL Driver  to work at a company located in the Rogers, AR area!

Job Title: CDL Driver

 

Job Location: Rogers 

 

Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: Up to $26/hr, Mon-Fri 6:30AM-4PM 

 

Position Summary: CDL Driver that is dependable, safety conscious. The driver will be responsible for safely operating company commercial motor vehicles, including standard manual transmission trucks—to transport scrap materials, roll-off containers, or structural steel products between our facility, local suppliers, and customer locations  

 

Key Responsibilities:  

Transport Operations: Safely drive and operate commercial trucks (such as roll-offs, flatbeds, or tractor-trailers), utilizing manual transmissions to navigate various road and yard conditions. 

 

Route Management: Navigate local and regional routes efficiently while strictly adhering to all Department of Transportation (DOT) rules, local traffic laws, and company safety guidelines. 

 

Loading & Unloading: Assist with or manage the secure loading, tarping, and unloading of materials, ensuring proper weight distribution and securement using chains, binders, or straps. 

 

Container Service: Drop off, pick up, and position roll-off or storage containers at commercial and industrial customer sites as requested. 

 

Vehicle Inspections: Conduct thorough pre-trip and post-trip inspections of the vehicle and equipment, documenting any mechanical issues or maintenance needs immediately. 

 

Yard Support: Assist with general scrap yard operations, material sorting, or equipment loading when not driving. 

Position Requirements:  

License: Valid Commercial Driver’s License (Class A or Class B CDL depending on assigned fleet equipment) without an airbrake restriction. 

 

Manual Transmission Proficiency: Required. Must have proven, hands-on experience and proficiency in operating heavy-duty commercial vehicles with manual transmissions (e.g., 8-speed, 9-speed, 10-speed, or similar shift patterns) without relying on automatic-only restrictions. 

 

Experience: Minimum 1–2 years of verifiable commercial driving experience; prior experience in the recycling, construction, or heavy-haul industry is strongly preferred. 

 

Certifications: Must maintain a valid DOT medical card and pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check. 

 

Physical Demands: Ability to sit for long periods, operate a clutch and manual shifter repeatedly, walk on uneven scrap-yard surfaces, climb ladders/stairs on trucks and trailers, and regularly lift up to 50 lbs.

The Quality Control Inspector- Ensures aviation articles meet manufacturer and operator specifications, including Dimensions, condition, operational limits, and compliance with the company’s Quality Management System. job.title: Mold Operator - 2nd Shift
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Molding Operator to work at a company located in the Battle Creek, MI area!

Job Title: MOLDING OPERATOR
 
Job Location: BATTLE CREEK MI 49037
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: 
1st SHIFT: 7:00 AM – 3:00 PM | $16.50/hr.
2nd SHIFT: 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM | $18.50/hr.
3rd SHIFT: 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM | $17.75/hr.
 
Job Description:                                                                               
JobSquad is seeking reliable and detail-oriented Molding Operators to join our client in Battle Creek, MI that is a leading manufacturer of advanced fiber-based products designed to solve noise, vibration, and thermal challenges in the automotive and industrial sectors. This position supports molding, oven, and trimming operations in a fast-paced production environment. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, dependable, and committed to producing high-quality products while meeting production goals.
 
• Previous manufacturing or production experience preferred
• Experience working in a fast-paced production environment preferred
• Strong hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity
• High attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to read and follow written instructions, SOPs, and work instruction
• Basic computer skills for data entry and production tracking
• Reliable attendance and punctuality
• Strong communication and teamwork skills
• Ability to work overtime as needed
• Must be able to pass a drug screen and background check
 
 
Physical Requirements
• Ability to regularly lift 50 pounds
• Ability to stand and walk for 8–10-hour shifts
• Frequent bending, twisting, stooping, reaching, and repetitive movements
• Ability to work near industrial ovens and manufacturing equipment
• Ability to work in a non-climate-controlled environment with varying temperatures
• Comfortable working in a loud, fast-paced manufacturing environment
• Ability to wear required PPE, including safety glasses, gloves, sleeves, and other protective equipment
 
Responsibilities of position
  1. Monitor oven cycles to ensure proper temperature, timing, and product quality
  2. prepare materials for production by staging fiber blankets and loading them into industrial ovens according to specifications
  3. Transfer heated materials into molds and operate molding equipment to form parts
  4. Operate waterjet and/or trim press equipment to remove excess material and finish parts
  5. Perform in-process and final quality inspections to identify defects or inconsistencies
  6. Label, package, and document finished products according to company standards
  7. Track production, material usage, and scrap in the Plex system
  8. Report on equipment issues, quality concerns, and safety hazards to leadership
  9. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area following 5S standards
  10. Work independently and collaboratively to meet production goals
  11. Follow all company policies, procedures, and safety guidelines
  12. Support continuous improvement initiatives and perform other duties as assigned

job.title: 2026 Road Construction Flagger
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Road Construction Flagger  to work at a company located in the Grand Rapids, MI area!

Job Title: 
Road Construction Flagger 
 
Job Location: 
Statewide Hiring Locations: Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Jackson, Mount Pleasant
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:
Hourly rate is based on the one-way distance from your home office to the assigned job site, calculated using the shortest available route in Google Maps.
  • 0–49 miles: $20.00/hour
  • 50–79 miles: $21.00/hour
  • 80–99 miles: $22.00/hour
  • 100+ miles: $27.00/hour 
 
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
What the Job Looks Like
  • Schedules are shared daily through our dispatch app (Assignar), by 7:00 PM each night.
  • Shifts typically range from 4 to 14 hours, depending on weather and project needs. (Not including travel time)
  • Work sites change daily. Statewide travel is required.
  • Overtime opportunities are available.
  • Because of the nature of roadwork, scheduled breaks aren’t always guaranteed—but we do our best to make sure you get rest when site conditions allow.
 
 
What You’ll Need
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Reliable personal vehicle (must remain on-site during your shift)
  • Proof of auto insurance (in your name/listed as an insured driver)
  • Availability for full days (sunrise to sunset), including weekends.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • No OWI/DUI within the past 5 years
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening.
  • Willingness to travel up to 100+ miles one way.
 
No experience? No problem. We provide training and safety equipment.
 
As a flagger, you’re an important part of keeping both workers and drivers safe. Your responsibilities include:
  • Controlling traffic through construction zones
  • Guiding drivers safely around work areas
  • Using signs, paddles, radios, and hand signals
  • Communicating with your team to keep traffic flowing smoothly.
 
PPE Provided by JobSquad:
  • Safety vest (MDOT Class 3)
  • Safety glasses (clear & tinted)
  • Hard hat
  • Sign & Poles
  • Headlamp
  • 2-way radio (you provide batteries)
  • Poncho
 
You’ll need to bring:
  • T-shirt or long-sleeved shirt (no tank tops)
  • Steel-toed leather boots (ankle coverage required)
  • Durable jeans or work pants (no shorts or sweatpants)
 
We’ve got you covered with a full range of benefits, including:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life and disability coverage
Plus, we offer a $100 referral bonus for every friend you bring on board—no limit.
 
Text “FLAG” to 269-279-7222 to apply!
